explanation: A deep inner calm and harmony that comes from God, regardless of external circumstances.
Never defiled; dedicated exclusively to God's service and purpose.
The gathering of believing Christians who form a local church community.
The physical or intellectual effort one performs to support oneself, as opposed to living at the expense of others.
An activity where someone takes from others without fair compensation; here used to describe those who live off work they have not done.
To stray from the truth or the right path, often by following false teaching or behavior.
A formal notice given to prevent someone from continuing a harmful action.
The ability to endure difficulties or provocations without becoming angry or giving up.
The act of bringing something back to its former, good condition; here used regarding God's ability to rebuild what has been destroyed.
